title: 3.16 La cena de los vecinos
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
goal: Help Ana run her building's international dinner: find the neighbors by job, by what they are doing, by their hair and by whose things they hold, find what each child wants to be and each country's food, and answer Ana's friends aloud about a guest's job, a guest's languages, Diego's brother and Sofia's bag.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.16 Cenas cruzadas: A1 closes Unit 3 at the community center's international dinner; A1+ 3.16 closes A1+ Unit 3 at the international dinner of Ana's building (the cast live on its floors 6 to 9, A1+ 2.7 and 3.13) with no new language. The learner finds the neighbors by job with a nationality before it (3.8), by what they are doing (3.3), by her or his hair (3.10) and by whose things they hold (3.11-3.12), finds what each child wants to be (3.14) and each country's food from an isn't clue (3.4, 3.8), and answers What does she do?, What language does he speak?, Diego's introduction of his brother and Is this your bag? aloud for Ana (3.9, 3.7, 3.1, 3.4 and 3.11).
speaking_outcome: Answer four friends aloud for Ana: what a guest does, which languages another guest speaks, a greeting for Diego's brother and whose bag Luis has found.

cards.audio_text: She's a Mexican nurse. He's a Canadian police officer. She's a Spanish cook. He's an American mechanic.
cards.pedagogy_note: Mission beat 01/10: the neighbors arrive at Ana's dinner straight from work; the learner hears one guest and discovers how the game responds, then finds the other three by their work clothes (3.8: a nationality before a job; the nationality is said, never read from the picture).
